description: Is a date a business day? If not, why (weekend, or which public holiday). Also the next and previous business day, and the month's business-day count, first and last business day. Use for office-open checks, shipping cut-offs, settlement dates. Country holidays, custom holidays and custom workweeks (e.g. Sun–Thu, Mon–Sat). First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

name: business_day

holiday.description: Holiday name if the date is a holiday

business_day_number.description: Which business day of the month this date is (1 = first); null if not a business day

reason.description: Why it is not a business day; null if it is

title: Business-day check
